title: Lawton, OK — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Lawton, OK: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Lawton is a city in OK with a population of 93,000. Southwest Oklahoma city with Fort Sill and the Wichita Mountains Wildlife Refuge. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.1.
